summary: Completed testing of new features: 1) Export Attendance to Excel/PDF with date range filter, 2) GPS Attendance approval workflow. All 14 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified export buttons in HR page and GPS approval workflow in Settings page.

attendance_export.description: Export attendance to Excel/PDF with date range filter

backend_tests.GET /api/hr/attendance/export/excel: PASS - Returns Excel file (150KB+) with date range support
backend_tests.GET /api/hr/attendance/export/pdf: PASS - Returns PDF file (377KB+) with date range support

frontend_tests.Attendance tab click: PASS - Tab with data-testid export fields visible
frontend_tests.Date range inputs: PASS - data-testid='export-date-from' and 'export-date-to' found and fillable

gps_attendance_workflow.description: GPS Attendance requires manager approval before being finalized

backend_tests.POST /api/tracking/gps-attendance: PASS - Returns requires_approval: true for GPS check-in
backend_tests.GET /api/tracking/gps-attendance/pending: PASS - Returns list of pending approval records

frontend_tests.GPS Approvals subtab: PASS - 'طلبات الموافقة GPS' subtab visible and clickable
frontend_tests.Pending approvals table: PASS - Shows employee name, date, request type, time, location

critical_code_review_comments: Export endpoints properly require authentication via get_current_user dependency
GPS attendance endpoints don't require authentication (by design for mobile tracking)
GPS approval workflow correctly sets status to 'pending_gps_approval' until approved
Approved GPS attendance status changes to 'present', rejected changes to 'gps_rejected'
Export date range uses start_date/end_date parameters as intended
Frontend data-testid attributes properly implemented for all interactive elements
seed_data_creation: Created multiple GPS check-in records for dates 2026-03-05 to 2026-03-09 for testing approval workflow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export attendance feature is in HR page (/hr) under Attendance tab (الحضور). GPS approval workflow is in Settings page (/settings) under Employee Tracking tab (تتبع الموظفين) > GPS Approvals subtab (طلبات الموافقة GPS). Test employee Hassan with ID dbf5cc42-7064-47d3-8a74-6a5f58f36c75 was used for GPS attendance testing.
